headline: The lemmings learned to lean
lede: Polish pass #3879's look slice shipped: SPIRE's plank road now rides the stair at an angle, the little brown figures got hair, a real walk cycle and per-skill poses, landings squash, and blasted wood throws splinters — all render-side, so every hash and proof rides unchanged.

notes.text: PR #3904 (merged a9bee12): sloped planks with a render-only lean toward the downhill neighbour — the sim grid never moves, so solver, replay and hash pins all hold.

lemcheck 314→333 (LOOK source-audit), --mutate 355/355, lemplay 66→71 with a deterministic attract pixel pin (32 tan nose px on SPIRE's laid chain) — plus hand mutations proving the slope and splinter pins actually bite.

Pixel pins belong in attract, not mid-play: the replay guarantees the road, the aim-bot doesn't. And SPIRE's stair steps two cells at a time — the lean reads reach-2 neighbours for exactly that reason.
#3879 stays open for QA: vents/trampolines/teleports (one per PR), float-while-digging, and 8–10 boards remain.
